description: Look up Receita's code tables by text or code. kind: cnae (activity), natureza_juridica (legal form), municipio, motivo (reason for status), qualificacao (partner role), pais. CNAE text returns ranked candidates using exact descriptions, curated everyday aliases, word matches and spelling suggestions. Read match_type, match_note and every official description; ambiguous terms are not an automatic classification. Numeric codes/prefixes keep the original lookup. Other tables use literal text. Use this before sector or municipio filtering.
name: lookup_codes
